name: dcw-platform
description: Public websites for Devdutta Creative World and IRISH — Master AI, presented by DCW.

scripts.build: npm run build -w dcw-web && npm run build -w irish-public
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w dcw-web && npm run lint -w irish-public && npm run lint -w @dcw/brand && npm run lint -w @dcw/config && npm run lint -w @dcw/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dcw/brand && npm run typecheck -w @dcw/config && npm run typecheck -w @dcw/ui && npm run typecheck -w dcw-web && npm run typecheck -w irish-public
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dcw/brand && npm run test -w @dcw/config && npm run test -w @dcw/ui && npm run test -w dcw-web && npm run test -w irish-public
